assertion_analysis.tests/standard_names/test_docs_contradic: Fails if contradiction, missing answer, or error is accepted, or if a supported claim is held; the expected stage is a fixed parameter independent of the persisted score.
Fail if the contradiction comment omits the authored sentence or the fixed DD source sentence.
Fail if a supported claim is clamped or given a contradiction comment.
Fails if no budget reserve occurs or its amount or phase changes.
Fails if the mocked reported spend is not passed to charge_event; it does not independently measure actual provider spend.
Fails if claim splitting omits or changes the fixed inward sentence.
Fails if the per-claim question key or Choice type is removed.
Fails if the batch produces no persisted result; it remains green if only the veto is removed.
